root_cause.text: The `usb_keene_probe` function in the radio-keene driver fails to release the initialized V4L2 control handler (`radio->hdl`) in its error cleanup path (`err_v4l2`) if subsequent registration steps fail.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl)` was removed from the immediate error check of `hdl->error` and instead placed in the common `err_v4l2` error path, ensuring it is called when `v4l2_device_register` or `video_register_device` fails.

index 000000000000..55bd1d2937c8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/drivers/media/radio/r
bic_trace_step.reason: In the `usb_keene_probe` function, if `v4l2_device_register` fails (line 368), the control flow jumps to `err_v4l2` (line 399). At `err_v4l2`, only `radio->buffer` and `radio` are freed, but `v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl)` is not called, resulting in a memory leak of the initialized control handler. Similarly, if `video_register_device` fails (line 390), it jumps to `err_vdev` (line 397) and falls through to `err_v4l2` without freeing the control handler.
